selection_rule: highest-ranked pre-registered arm on internal genus-level macro AUPRC that is not significantly worse than another pre-registered arm on the external novel-genus set (docs/deviations.md #16, #21); a research-loop variant displaces it only if it also confirms externally.
note: arms whose 95% cluster-bootstrap CI of the macro-AUPRC difference includes 0 are statistically tied with the released arm; the choice among tied arms is not a claim of superiority
deployment_note: Decision of the authors 2026-09-21: deploy the KO + Bacformer-large fusion for TogoMCP. Basis: best internal macro AUPRC (0.625 vs 0.576, significant) and the top rank among five saved models on 100 novel organisms (AUROC 0.746 vs B2 0.732, AUPRC 0.858 vs 0.851; differences not statistically resolved). B2 remains the pre-registered rule's choice and is the CPU-only fallback for genomes without a Bacformer-large vector. Both models are trained on all 358 labelled genomes with per-trait class balancing (class_weight=balanced for logistic regression, scale_pos_weight=n_neg/n_pos for XGBoost).
switch_note: 21 October 2026: the random forest on the 852-KO panel replaced B2 (now RedoxKO-LX) after it did better on the external genomes (+0.043 macro AUPRC [0.018, 0.069], also without FAPROTAX-derived labels), in yes/no calls on new species (MCC +0.056 [0.006, 0.115]) and on incomplete MAGs; decision made after these tests, reported in Supplementary Note 1.
